title: The Barber Who Was Also a Surgeon
hook: Need a haircut and an amputation?

scenes.text: In medieval Europe, you did not visit a medical doctor for a tooth extraction or surgery.

scenes.text: Instead, you visited the local barber. They handled razors, shears, and bloodletting lancets.
